subject: READY_FOR_PRIMARY: Gen7 Core V1 cross-gap pseudo-reversal independently reproduced
body: Manager independently revalidated the reversal/reacquisition handoff against Primary Gen7 Core V1 package sha256 1eb02d62d58d8baf42c020993455c96028b5793c34136e2f4fcab63ee4b9e20e at GitHub baseline 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. READY_FOR_PRIMARY for the causal fix + regression: break pre-gap direction continuity before reversal evaluation; first post-gap segment cannot itself prove reversal; re-establish direction from fresh samples.
